sqliteSql: SELECT s.product_id FROM snap s LEFT JOIN outbound o ON s.warehouse_id=o.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=o.product_id WHERE s.quantity*s.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(o.quantity,0)<20 ORDER BY s.product_id
